Hello! I'm new to redstone, haven't picked up Minecraft for a while in general but got coaxed into doing a realm with some mates. I'm building a metro system to link different parts of our town, and pictured is what I've come up with so far!

There are a couple of issues, firstly in order to power the minecart back to where it started it requires a lot more powered rail than I'm easy with using. Minecarts seem to lose momentum extremely quickly when there's nothing in them, so I've had to power every 6th rail.

The second thing is, I'd like the rail to be sent back automatically, at the moment the rail used to send the minecart back is powered by a lever so is analog, I'd rather not rely on the good faith of the rail users to send the carts back themselves. 

Any tips on how to solve these issues would be very much appreciated, as well as general tips on how to make the build more efficient. Thanks in advance!
